text: The parish registers of Ashworth survive, with lamentable gaps, from 1563 onward. Their omissions are themselves instructive: no baptisms were recorded during the winter of 1647, when the incumbent, a Mr. Thomas Greaves, appears to have absconded rather than subscribe to the Covenant. His successor, whose hand is cramped and idiosyncratic, entered marriages and burials indiscriminately on the same leaves. Historians have tended to treat such irregularities as clerical negligence; I am inclined to read them otherwise — as the residue of a community whose ecclesiastical loyalties were, for a decade at least, genuinely unsettled.
